title: Personal Genome Pipeline Parameters
description: Whole genome sequencing from FASTQ, BAM or VCF to clinical interpretation

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated samplesheet: sample, then fastq_1,fastq_2 (aligned and called), or bam,bam_index (called), or vcf,vcf_index with an optional bam,bam_index; sex (male or female) is required on every row that is called and when expansion_hunter is enabled.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.

allow_unfiltered.description: Accept a VCF that has no FILTER=PASS record by treating FILTER '.' as PASS. Without it such a VCF stops the run, because every PASS-only step would report zero hits.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.

reads_to_vcf_options.title: Reads to VCF
reads_to_vcf_options.description: Alignment and variant calling of the samplesheet rows that start from FASTQ or from a BAM without a VCF.

skip_trim.description: Align the raw reads, without fastp trimming (SKIP_TRIM=true in scripts/01b-fastp-qc.sh).

minimap2_index.description: minimap2 index built with -x sr. Default: <reference base>.sr.mmi beside the FASTA, the file scripts/02-alignment.sh builds; when neither exists the run builds one.

intervals.description: Space-separated regions DeepVariant calls (its --regions, INTERVALS in scripts/03-deepvariant.sh). Unset calls the whole genome.

sex_check.description: What to do when the sex inferred from a BAM differs from the samplesheet's, by indexcov (every BAM, before any BAM step) or by somalier (with sample_qc): fail stops the run; warn logs it and goes on with the declared sex.

reference_data.title: Reference data
reference_data.description: Paths to reference files required by the pipeline.

reference.description: Path to the GRCh38 reference FASTA the BAMs were aligned to: the no-ALT analysis set that scripts/setup.sh installs as reference/GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set.fasta.

clinvar.description: Path to ClinVar pathogenic VCF (bgzipped). Optional — skip ClinVar screen if not provided.

clinvar_index.description: Path to ClinVar pathogenic VCF tabix index (.tbi).

tool_selection.title: Tool selection
tool_selection.description: Control which analysis tools to run.

tools.description: Comma-separated list of tools to run; an unknown name stops the run. DB-heavy tools (vep, slivar, clinical_filter, cpsr, clinvar, expansion_hunter, sample_qc) and extras (stranger, ancestry, pypgx, SV callers, cram_archive) are opt-in. prs and vcfanno are skipped with a warning until --pgs_scoring or a score file is set.

annotation_databases.title: Annotation databases
annotation_databases.description: Paths to annotation databases. Some tools (VEP, CPSR, ExpansionHunter) require their databases and will fail at startup if enabled without them. Others produce degraded output with warnings.

vep_cache_cpsr.description: VEP cache for CPSR (release 115, PCGR_VEP_CACHE_RELEASE in versions.env; separate from the VEP step's release 116 cache).

pypgx_bundle.description: pypgx-bundle reference data directory for star allele calling.

gnomad_constraint.description: gnomAD gene constraint TSV (LOEUF, pLI scores).

clinical_genetics.title: Clinical & population genetics
clinical_genetics.description: Paths to clinical and population genetics reference data.

ancestry_ref.description: Ancestry reference panel VCF for PCA projection.

hla_dat.description: Pre-downloaded IPD-IMGT/HLA hla.dat file for T1K HLA typing.

hla_genes.description: Gene annotation (GTF) T1K takes each HLA gene's GRCh38 coordinates from: the gene lines of GENCODE's basic annotation that scripts/setup.sh installs as reference/gencode.v<release>.basic.genes.gtf. Required with hla_typing.

slivar_bin.description: Deprecated and ignored: slivar now runs from the pinned image (SLIVAR_IMAGE in versions.env). Accepted with a warning for this release only.

cnvpytor_resources.description: Directory with the pinned CNVpytor GC and mask .pytor files (see docs/00-reference-setup.md). Required by cnvpytor: the 1.3.2 image ships without them.

annotsv_annotations.description: AnnotSV annotation directory (contains Annotations_Human/), built once with AnnotSV's INSTALL_annotations.sh. Required by annotsv: the AnnotSV image ships no annotation data.

delly_exclude.description: Optional Delly exclude map, passed as `delly sr -x` (for example Delly's excludeTemplates/human.hg38.excl.tsv).

manta_call_regions.description: Optional bgzipped BED of the regions Manta calls on, passed as `configManta.py --callRegions`; its .tbi must sit beside it. For example chr1-22, X and Y, which keeps Manta off the ALT, decoy and unplaced contigs.

cytoband.description: Optional UCSC GRCh38 chromosome bands (cytoBand.hg38.txt, chr1-22, X and Y; scripts/setup.sh installs it), passed as `telomerehunter -b`. Without it TelomereHunter uses its own hg19 bands.

somalier_sites.description: somalier's GRCh38 sites VCF (sites.hg38.vcf.gz; scripts/setup.sh installs it under reference/somalier/). Required by sample_qc.

verifybamid2_panel.description: Folder holding VerifyBamID2's marker panel, the .UD, .mu and .bed files of one prefix (scripts/setup.sh installs the 1000 Genomes 100k GRCh38 panel under reference/verifybamid2/). Required by sample_qc.

freemix_warn.description: VerifyBamID2's FREEMIX (estimated share of reads from another person) above which sample_qc reports possible contamination. A warning only; it never stops the run.

resource_limits.title: Resource limits
resource_limits.description: Set maximum resource limits for the pipeline.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job.

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job.

max_time.description: Maximum amount of time that can be requested for any single job.
